coast.source: Medium resolution vector polygons of the Antarctic coastline 7.7
coast.credit: SCAR Antarctic Digital Database; UK Polar Data Centre
coast.description: One continental outline including ice shelves, ice tongues and ice rises; no territorial sectors. Shared maps use a 500 m simplification; the Antarctica map uses the full medium-resolution coast.

treaty.note: Article IV preserves positions on territorial claims without resolving sovereignty.

coverage.policy: All listed facilities south of 60°S, including stations, camps and support sites. Subantarctic sites north of the Treaty area are excluded. Statuses refer to this edition, not a live operating report. Coordinates retain the source precision; moving ice-shelf stations can move.
